cards.headline:
Google says AI search queries
now run three times longer
cards.body: Google told advertisers one in six searches is multimodal, but its May data limited that figure to U.S. AI Mode.

blocks.x: Google told advertisers that AI search queries now run three times longer, and that one in six searches is multimodal, according to Google's Shivani Mohan.
Google's May data limited the multimodal figure to U.S. AI Mode, which raises the question of which other figures lack a baseline.
